# Keep tag-event count comments aligned with the actual assertion

The current test comment still says three tag events and waits for the third, but the options request numberOfEventsToCollapse: 2 and assertions contain two transitions. Recommend updating this local comment when changing the test. It is a concrete prose-versus-test mismatch, not evidence that the production API guarantees exactly two notifications for every tag change. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.

Scope: extension message update tests.
